risk_summary: The disclosure presents an ambitious growth and fleet-investment strategy with substantial execution, operational, macroeconomic, fuel, labor, supply-chain, geopolitical, and pandemic-related risks. It includes meaningful quantitative details, but several forward-looking benefits and outcomes are expressed through noncommittal expectations and broad risk-factor language. Floating-rate debt and withholding-tax exposure add material financial sensitivity.
